[P2] Approach: reconcile the conformance rollout decision

The description says enabling telemetry-2 is deferred to a follow-up pin change, but this change enables it now. The unchanged exporter still omits `cause`, so this selects a requirement the description explicitly says cannot pass. Rule 7, “List the decisions that the task did not cover,” requires this rollout choice and its reason in the description. Please return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, agree on the ordering of exporter support and test enablement, and align the description and implementation with that decision.
